intro.title: Express performance
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple Express server that uses built-in performance techniques to handle requests faster. You will learn the core concept of middleware chaining to optimize response times by minimizing processing steps. The main technologies involved are the Express framework, its routing system, and the native Node.js HTTP module. By the end, you'll understand how to structure an application for better speed and efficiency, which is essential for any web service.
intro.usecase: Express performance optimization is crucial for high-traffic applications like e-commerce platforms during flash sales, where thousands of users simultaneously browse products and add items to carts. In social media dashboards, optimized Express servers ensure real-time updates load instantly as users scroll through feeds and notifications. API-driven admin panels rely on performance tuning to handle complex data filtering and reporting queries without lag. Developers implement these techniques to prevent slowdowns during peak usage, ensuring responsive user experiences across web applications.
